description.en: A portable plugin that bundles Ascend/GitCode developer skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Agent Plugins hosts: scenario-driven fuzzing, GitCode CLI, GitCode PR review, release notes, Ascend interface auditing, and documentation UX review.
description.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 宿主的通用插件，打包昇腾/GitCode 开发常用技能：场景化 fuzz、GitCode CLI、PR 审查、Release Note、昇腾接口梳理与文档体验审查。

description.en: Skills for Ascend/CANN development and GitCode workflows.
description.zh: 面向昇腾/CANN 开发与 GitCode 工作流的技能集合。

description.en: Scenario-driven white-box fuzz testing for a repository or feature: build a usage-context picture first, then design cases, run them for real evidence, and report.
description.zh: 对代码仓或特性做场景化白盒自动测试与 fuzz：先建立使用场景画像，再设计用例、真实运行取证并输出报告。

description.en: End-to-end GitCode work from the terminal with the gitcode CLI: repositories, issues, PRs, releases, pipelines, search, and raw API fallback.
description.zh: 用 gitcode CLI 在 GitCode 完成端到端研发操作：仓库、Issue、PR、Release、流水线、搜索，以及用 gitcode api 兜底 REST 接口。

description.en: Audit northbound (exposed) and southbound (consumed) interfaces of Ascend/CANN repositories and write the fixed-template Excel report.
description.zh: 梳理昇腾/Ascend 代码仓的南北向接口，按固定模板输出 Excel。

description.en: Deep GitCode PR review using PR metadata, diff, call chains, and repository context; can publish inline comments back to the PR.
description.zh: 结合 PR metadata、diff 与整个代码仓上下文深入审查 GitCode PR，可发布逐行评论。

description.en: Generate formal release notes from real GitCode repository data: roadmap, PRs, issues, tags, and repository docs.
description.zh: 基于 GitCode 仓库真实数据（roadmap、PR、Issue、release/tag 与仓库文档）生成正式风格的 Release Note。

description.en: Follow a repository's README, install guide, or quick start exactly as a first-time user and report where onboarding breaks and which documentation needs work.
description.zh: 像第一次接触项目的人一样，真实按仓库的 README、安装文档或 quick start 跑一遍，判断新人能否走通、文档是否可用、卡在哪里。
